GOVERNANCE_TOOL_MODE.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored. Since interface release 1.6.0 the server advertises one complete tool catalog on every transport, so no value here narrows or widens what tools/list returns; the contract's mode field always reports full. The key stays settable so an existing deployment's value remains valid.

UNITARES_KNOWLEDGE_BACKEND.description: PostgreSQL full-text search is the default. AGE enables graph-specific knowledge operations. Both use the private bundled PostgreSQL instance.

UNITARES_BUNDLE_STARTUP_TIMEOUT.description: Internal per-service readiness budget in seconds; cannot override Glama's own startup deadline.
